bug_info.bug_desc: The watermark event output is asserted whenever watermark_cross is true and watermark_crossed is false, without checking that the module is active. Since watermark_crossed is only latched inside the active-qualified always_ff block, an inactive cycle that happens to satisfy the address comparison (for example, while the module is idle and the address points to a mailbox region) can produce a false single-cycle watermark event. This violates the requirement that both event outputs be deasserted whenever the module is inactive.
bug_info.fix_hint: Qualify the watermark event output with the active signal so it can only pulse when the module is actually monitoring read-buffer accesses. The corrected expression should gate the existing sticky condition with active, such as: event_watermark_o = active && !watermark_crossed && watermark_cross;
